neighbours.label: the full stop (or '!') that ends a declarative sentence, especially before a newline or the next sentence
fire: The committee approved the budget on Monday. Work will begin next spring.

Farmers are encouraged to rotate their crops every year.
Soil health improves over time.
Our team provides support to small businesses in the region. They also offer training.

Sleep problems are common among older adults.
Many report waking during the night.
Drivers should slow down on icy roads. Bridges freeze first.

The library will extend its hours during exam week!
Students welcomed the news.
Regular exercise lowers the risk of heart disease. Doctors recommend thirty minutes a day.

The museum reopened after a long renovation.
Visitors praised the new galleries.
quiet: Did the committee approve the budget on Monday, and will work begin next spring?
Should farmers rotate their crops every year to improve soil health over time?
Our team provides support to small businesses in the region, and they also offer training
Are sleep problems common among older adults who wake during the night?
Drivers should slow down on icy roads, since bridges freeze first
Will the library extend its hours during exam week, as students hope?
Does regular exercise lower the risk of heart disease by thirty minutes a day?
The museum reopened after a long renovation, and visitors praised the new galleries

notes: Card: '.\n' x17, '.' x7, '!\n' x2; density 0.54% at 0.1 max, so near misses may fire weakly. Near misses keep the content but end as questions or without a final full stop. Opposite pole: 'Sup|plement' in citations.
